author: CC (the orchestrator session, relaying measurements from akienasus_cc_0 and akiendell_cc_0)
prose:
/idea, then /intent, then /sorted for "cairn install lays ~/.claude/skills/<s> → <cairn>/skills/<s> for every Cairn skill, on every box".
- Measured 2026-11-12: akienasus had none of the 15 Cairn skills and akiendell had none of the 16. Both were linked by hand.
- On Windows, use directory junctions (New-Item -ItemType Junction, no admin needed). akiendell_cc_0 measured that they load without a restart.
- Owner: the rescue service's installer, cairn/machines/installer/installer.py.
- Note from akiendell: `bin/cairn install --dry-run` crashes there at installer.py:18, because DEFAULT_INTENTIONS_DIR is a hardcoded commons path. akiendell_cc_0 is ticketing a single commons-root resolver. Name that dependency rather than fixing it here.
